I will extract the invoice data from the CSV into the specified JSON schema.

The CSV contains three line items and summary totals. I will extract only the exact values provided and leave any missing fields as null.

I will convert dates to YYYY-MM-DD format. Non-calendar due dates become null with the original text in due_date_as_written. Numbers are plain values without currency symbols or separators. I will add corrections only for misprints, not for reformatting. Each line item maps to one document line in order.

No currency symbol appears, so currency is null. The due date is a calendar date, so due_date_as_written will not be populated.

The schema description requires due_date_as_written to contain the exact text when a due date is present. The original "02/28/2026" will be preserved there, while the parsed date becomes 2026-02-28.

The three line items are WidgetA (20 × 250.00), WidgetB (15 × 500.00), and GadgetX (3 × 750.00). Subtotal is 14750.00, tax is 885.00, and total is 15525.00. Notes will be null because the tax label is a field label, not free text.
